This post has `status: preview`, so it's reachable at
`/api/entries/preview-example` but appears in no list, feed, tag count, or
sitemap. That's what makes it useful for sharing a draft with someone before
launch — send them the link and they'll see the real rendered page.

It is unlisted, not protected: anyone who knows or guesses the slug can read it.
Don't put anything sensitive behind it.

Change `status` to `published` when it's ready.
